column7: Every operator-supplied input path of the CLI (compliance verify --file/--sig, bundle verify and bundle import --license, license token file, secret export --encrypt-to / secret import --decrypt-with key files, secret render template, secret import --file in every format, secret create --from-file, the stored credentials file) hung in open(2) on a FIFO. Each now goes through cli/internal/regularfile (O_NONBLOCK open plus fstat of the opened descriptor); one table row per entry point, each must refuse the FIFO within 1s and name the path. PR #3186.
